facts.fact: The communications minister said in an interview published 4 March 2025 that his ministry had drawn up a programme of interconnection and modernisation of the administration to connect all communes and the public administration within them, but that it awaited adoption of the national digital policy, the country having no adopted digital policy at that date; the interview gives no other date, so the date is its publication date.
